gap: No result ChatGPT got states how many swims one charge covers or what each hour of runtime costs. MOJAWA Run Plus: Headphones Addict measured 8 h 43 min at 50% volume, which works out to 11 full 45-minute swims per charge, or $11.47 per hour of runtime at $99.99. FINIS Duo: 7 h rated, so 9 swims per charge.
standout_why: SoundMavericks (cited in chat 3) gives battery hours for FINIS Duo (7 h), PSIER S18 (8 h), Nank Runner Diver2 Pro (10 h) and both Shokz models (6 h in MP3 mode for OpenSwim Pro). It shows no prices, no sessions per charge and no measured runtime. Our own current page (cited in chats 2 and 3) already shows the Run Plus 8 h 43 min test, but it doesn't say how many swims that covers or what each hour costs. I couldn't open WIRED, TechRadar or Verywell Fit: WIRED and Verywell Fit refused the fetch, and TechRadar returned only page titles. So I can't confirm those three lack the figure. A reader can also work out sessions per charge from SoundMavericks' hours on their own. That makes the finding only partly new.
decides: It backs the Run Plus as the under-$100 pick for runtime: 11 measured 45-minute swims per charge against 9 rated for the FINIS Duo, and a full recharge in 50 minutes. Two price checks change the page. First, Jabees sells the 7Seven for $59.99 on its own store today. ChatGPT quoted $74–80, so the value pick is about $40 cheaper than the Run Plus, not $20–25. Its runtime is still unsourced, so I can't give it a swims-per-charge figure. Second, MOJAWA sells the Purra Swim for $169.99, so it should come out of the under-$100 table on our current page.
